name: Breakdown abroad in Polish
blurb: Switches to Polish, roaming line drops
title: Overheated on a German motorway, continued in Polish
summary: A UK member driving home to Poland has broken down at a German motorway services on a roaming line that keeps dropping. He switches to Polish and gives up if the agent stays in English. The motorway and rest area must be repeated rather than guessed, he murmurs through the cover explanation, and he needs a hire car as well as the tow. Restarting the explanation or getting the return date wrong sends him to a German recovery firm.

golden.scenario: Caller's car has overheated at a motorway services in Germany and he needs to reach Poznań for a wedding on Saturday.
golden.expected_outcome: After the switch the agent speaks Polish for the rest of the call. The agent asks him to repeat when the line breaks up, and records Raststätte Eichenhain on the A2 towards Berlin. The agent keeps talking through both acknowledgements while it explains the European cover. Recovery is sent for an overheated engine and a hire car is booked until Monday 17 August.

caller.description: Lorry mechanic driving home for a wedding, practical.

agent_setup.knowledge: European cover: tow to the nearest approved garage. Hire car up to 7 days. Repairs abroad are paid by the member and claimed back.

nodes.say: Hello, good morning. My car is broken. I am in Germany, on the way to Poland.
Yes, safe, I am at the services. Przepraszam, czy mogę mówić po polsku? Tak będzie mi łatwiej.
Po polsku, proszę. Nie wszystko rozumiem po angielsku.
Numer polisy to E U, cztery cztery, zero siedem, dwa dziewięć.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the policy number

nodes.say: Rejestracja: Y, D, sześć siedem, P, K, M.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the registration

nodes.say: Stoję na parkingu Raststätte Eichenhain, autostrada A dwa, kierunek Berlin, niedaleko Magdeburga.
A dwa. Kierunek Berlin. Parking Eichenhain.
Nie, nie. A dwa. Dwa. Parking Eichenhain.
Silnik się przegrzał. Kontrolka temperatury świeci na czerwono i wyciekł płyn chłodniczy.
Rozumiem. A ile to potrwa, zanim przyjedzie laweta?
Słyszałem, proszę nie zaczynać od początku. Ile to potrwa?
Dobrze. I druga sprawa: potrzebuję samochodu zastępczego, żeby dojechać do Poznania. W sobotę jest wesele mojej siostry.
Dziękuję, zadzwonię po niemiecką pomoc drogową.
